career_ladder.note: Career progression applies to Medical Officers in the Central Health Service (CHS) and Assistant Divisional Medical Officers (ADMO) in Indian Railways. Medical officers are eligible for Dynamic Assured Career Progression (DACP) scheme time-scale upgrades up to Senior Administrative Grade without linkage to vacancies.

exam_scheme.note: The Combined Medical Services Examination consists of two parts: Part I Computer-Based Examination (two objective papers, 250 marks each = 500 marks total) and Part II Personality Test / Interview (100 marks) for a total aggregate of 600 marks. In Part I objective questions, one-third (0.33) marks are deducted as penalty for each wrong answer.

financial_package.estimate_note: Medical officers receive a statutory Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) of 20% of basic pay (₹11,220 at entry). Dearness Allowance at 58% is calculated on Basic Pay + NPA. Gross and in-hand ranges include NPA, HRA, and Transport Allowance.
official_perks: Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) at 20% of Basic Pay
Government medical officer quarters or House Rent Allowance (27%/18%/9%)
Annual Book and Equipment Allowance for medical literature
Study leave and academic sponsorship for post-graduate medical qualifications
Comprehensive medical coverage under Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS)
